messages:
ravi: Halcyon Micro asked for a tight perf/W + kernel tuning recipe for their M4 board. Need a reproducible protocol and CSV outputs for marketplace. @emily @courtney can you propose a minimal run?
emily: Propose minimal sweep: model=redwood-7b / llama-7b, seq=512/2048, powercaps=75/120/160W, quants=q4_0 + int8. Metrics: avg_power_w (5Hz), p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput_tps, and per_token_joules. Capture NVML + PMU counters.
courtney: Lab slot Thu 13:00-16:00 PT is free. Kernel knobs to test: isolcpus=3-6 nohz_full=3-6 rcu_nocbs=3-6 cpu governor sched_migration_cost_ns tweaks. Example run command below:
```
# run example
KERNEL_FLAGS="isolcpus=3-6 nohz_full=3-6 rcu_nocbs=3-6"
./bench.py --model redwood-7b --seq 2048 --batch 2 --quant q4_0 --powercap 120 --out s3://redwood-bench/halcyon/1765554321/
```
ravi: Acceptance criteria requested by partner: perf/W >= baseline + 10% at 120W OR p99 < 200ms at seq=2048. They also want a one-pager and raw CSVs.
emily: I'll author runbook and CSV schema. CSV header: run_id,model,seq,powercap,quant,batch,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tps,avg_power_w,per_token_joules.
courtney: Dataset: 400 curated prompts staged at /data/bench/halcyon/400.jsonl.gz. I'll checksum and stage. Doing a smoke tonight.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-8277 created, label=halcyon-micro. Tag experiments with "halcyon-m4-2026". Reminder: include firmware version and driver ABI in run metadata.
ravi: Action items: Emily -> runbook + telemetry hooks; Courtney -> smoke + dataset + rack prep; I'll draft partner one-pager and schedule Fri sync. Proceed if smoke pass.
emily: Ack. Will include Grafana link and alert thresholds.
courtney: Ack. Smoke tonight and upload artifacts.
ravi: Thanks team, looping Halcyon contact after smoke. :thumbsup:
